prerequisite: Normal Mac/CUA input restored; one normal unlock request pending. No CLI, sharing, lock, authentication or protection workaround.
first_step: Inspect current foreground, cancel only a proven unsubmitted own line if needed, prove harmless ordinary guest input and immediate result. Do not assume a readable frame is input readiness.

file_gate.notes: Fresh actual guest bytes/hash/directory checks required. Prior helper transport pins different binary; do not replay it or disguise the new binary under its old pinned name. A new exact-file transport descriptor requires current host/peer identity and exclusive write; no host folder/clipboard share. No transfer listener has been started.

fixture_run.launch: Normal ordinary .NET Process with exact existing fixture FileName/WorkingDirectory, UseShellExecute=false. Retain owned process object/handle before reading PID. Prepare variables before the short launch/read sequence; no debugger flags or argument overrides.
fixture_run.immediate_evidence: Fixture ready/PID, helper complete output and immediately captured LASTEXITCODE, actual base, exactly6624B snapshot and SHA256; no inference from typing alone.
fixture_run.lifecycle: Wait up to40seconds for the same fixture's natural completion, capture HasExited and actual exit code if nonblank, retain unknown if blank. No forced termination or new run to fill missing data.
fixture_run.byte_validation: Private capture returned through a fresh exact-file local transfer only after metadata is known. Full comparison to fixture_oracle with that same observed base and245HIGHLOW fixups. Hash and length alone do not qualify read content. No receiver/listener has been started.
fixture_run.new_rejection_cases: Only own/fixture scope and no overwrite. Exact invalid CLI before process access and wrong fixed-profile own process may be checked; do not treat old 8B observer rejection cases as this binary's evidence.

game_gate: This plan does not launch or read the original game. After actual fixture acceptance, establish new dependencies/Win7/recovery/path/hash and a separate concrete bounded diagnostic-startup plan. Diagnostic no-argument startup is separate from normal authenticated launcher entry. No account exists and none is requested.
stop_conditions: Unexpected permission, new agreement or credential requirement
